title: review: H5a fix round 1: codex_reply rounds replace the previous round's posted result instead of being dropped, and the commit sha is parsed only from an explicit commit label or a full 40-char sha (review T-0368)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain 2de1126 (T-0358, H5a) in git log; never drop or amend it.
Review T-0368 on T-0358, both findings to address:
1. (high) orchestrator/mcp.py:96 post_tool_result posts only while the task's bus status is running; the first codex() round flips it to done, so a later codex_reply round (the documented fix-loop path) finds status done and silently returns posted: false, leaving the stale round-1 result (wrong sha, wrong summary) on the bus. Rule: a codex_reply round always re-posts for a task that is assigned to codex and not yet merged (merged_into is null): it replaces summary, commit, usage and increments result.rounds, keeping result.previous_commits as a list; a fresh codex() on a task that already carries a result from a different thread posts only when the task is running (today's guard), otherwise returns posted: false with reason "result exists from thread <id>". Tests: rename test_codex_reply_does_not_overwrite_existing_result to test_codex_reply_replaces_previous_round_result (asserts the new sha and rounds == 2) and add test_codex_fresh_thread_does_not_overwrite_done_task.
2. (med) orchestrator/executor.py:133 the commit regex matches any bare 7-plus hex run in the free-form message (a "1234567-row migration" becomes the commit). Accept only: a 40-char hex sha anywhere, or a 7-40 char hex run directly preceded by the words commit, committed, commit sha, sha, HEAD is now at, or inside backticks after the word Commit on the same line; otherwise fall through to git rev-parse HEAD in the worktree. Test: test_commit_sha_parse_requires_label_or_full_sha with the migration example (falls through) and three labelled forms (parsed).
Keep the T-0358 tests and every existing test green. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root until it exits 0, then git add -A and git commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows 2de1126 below your commit
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree

comments.issue: post_tool_result's guard against clobbering a done task's result only rejects when `previous is not None and status != "running"`. But executor.start() unconditionally calls bus.claim(task_id, "codex", worktree) before post_tool_result ever runs, which flips status to "running" on ANY task_id (even one already done/merged) while leaving the old `result` field intact. So a second real codex(task_id, prompt) call on an already-completed task (e.g. Planner retry after a dropped MCP response) makes post_tool_result see status="running" with a non-null previous result, both elif branches evaluate False, and the guard is skipped: the prior commit/thread/rounds/provenance is silently overwritten with no previous_commits entry and no merged_into check (that check only exists in the replace_result branch). test_codex_fresh_thread_does_not_overwrite_done_task passes only because it mocks executor.start, so the real bus.claim side effect that causes this never fires in the test.
